endpoint.name: Search job postings
endpoint.summary: Search open jobs read from employers' own career pages by title, keyword, place, remote, salary, experience, company, funding or posted date. Each job has its description, posted pay, locations, skills, apply link and a company profile.

cost.note: One credit per job returned; an empty page is free. treg holds limit jobs (10 when omitted).

input.note: Unknown fields answer 422. A multi-location posting comes back as one row per location.

job_titles.note: OR'd. An unquoted entry needs every word in the title, in any order; wrap it in quotes for the exact phrase; prefix - to exclude

keywords.note: ranked against description, skills and technologies; prefix - to exclude

geo_locations.note: [{city, region, country}], any subset; each is geocoded, so a free-text place works in city alone ({city: 'New York, NY'}, {city: 'Texas'}). A city matches its metro area; a place that cannot be found, "Remote" included, is not filtered on: use location_types for remote

experience.note: years-of-experience bands, not seniority: Entry, Junior, Mid, Senior or Executive (Executive is 10+ years, mostly senior and staff roles). For the level a job is labelled with, use experience_levels

experience_levels.note: the job's experience_level label: Entry-Level, Junior / Associate, Mid-Level, Senior, Principal / Staff / Lead or Executive. total_count ignores it and counts as if it were absent

job_types.note: Full Time, Part Time, Contract or Internship

company_name.note: one company's name, case ignored; a known variant finds it ('Ford Motor Company' finds Ford), but 'Ramp' never finds LiveRamp or Kramp

company_slug.note: Hirebase company slugs; resolve one with hirebase.companies.search

ingested_after.note: ISO-8601; only jobs Hirebase first saw at or after this time. For polling new jobs, with sort_by first_ingested

exclude_job_board.note: ["linkedin"] keeps only jobs read from career pages

return_raw_description.note: "true" adds description_raw, the full HTML from the job system

limit.note: jobs per page, and the price: each job returned is charged

jobs.location_raw: New York, NY (HQ); San Francisco, CA
